name: CKEditor5 Bootstrap Integration
description: Adds CKEditor 5 widgets for Bootstrap 5 (Bootstrap Div and Bootstrap Table).
project_description:
Provide widget CKEditor 5 for Bootstrap 5. best use with bootstrap 5 admin theme.

Configuration / Text formats and editors and active 3 buttons

 🟦 Button : Bootstrap Div

 
 
 Insert the div tag into the content.
 
 
 Popup dialog with the following features:
 
 
 Add custm class Bootstrap 5 or select option for (container, row, col-*, d-flex, p-3, bg-light …)
 
 
 Background image: URL, position (center/top/bottom…), size (cover/contain…).
 
 
 AOS (Animate On Scroll): select animation (fade-up, zoom-in …), duration, delay, anchor-placement.
 
 
 Custom attributes: add/remove attribute (data-, aria-, …).
 
 
 
 
 Double-click to div for mode editor.
 
 
 Div highlight with blue border in editing view.
 
 
 Move div block to up/down
 
 
 Insert div before/after block
 
 
 🟩 Button Bootstrap Table

 
 
 Balloon toolbar on table.
 
 
 Balloon smaller features:
 
 
 Field Caption — add/remove .
 
 
 Checkboxes Bootstrap table classes:
 
 
 Base: table
 
 
 Style: table-striped, table-bordered, table-hover, table-sm …
 
 
 Color: table-primary, table-dark …
 
 
 Responsive: table-responsive, table-responsive-md …
 
 
 Caption: caption-top
